val.v01: NGROUP cannot be 0. It must specify the number of flux spectrum groups.
val.v02: IHEAD must be a positive integer (≥ 1). Current value: {ihead}.
val.v03: Card #7 (FT) must contain {exp} values (|NGROUP| = {exp}), but contains {got}.
val.v04: Card #6 (CX) must contain {exp} values (|NGROUP|+1 with IESF=5), but contains {got}.
val.v05: For IESF={iesf} ({name}), {exp} groups are expected; |NGROUP| indicates {got}.
val.v06: Card #4 — EB1 and EB2 must be positive (EB1={eb1}, EB2={eb2}). Recommended: 5×10⁶ and 2×10⁵ eV.
val.v07: Card #4 — EB1 must be greater than EB2 (EB1={eb1} > EB2={eb2} is false).
val.v08: All FT flux values are zero. Without a neutron flux COLLAPS cannot compute effective cross sections.
val.v09: Negative values found in FT. Neutron flux values must be non-negative.
val.v10: With ISFIS=1 and IGEN=1, COLLAPS will only generate the extended EFY libraries and stop. No collapsed cross-section library will be produced.
val.v11: With ISFIS=1 and ISOCA=0, COLLAPS will read the extended EFY library (Unit 18 / EFYBL.dat). Make sure this file exists in the run directory.
val.v12: ILIB={ilib} ({lib}) and IESF={iesf} ({esf}) use different group structures. COLLAPS will internally convert the spectrum before collapsing.
